title: Getting hired to sing at the Vendome and dressing from thrift shops
summary: The hotel hired her to sing with the home-town musicians. Worried about having no clothes, she bought gowns at thrift shops and impressed Mrs. Clore with her wardrobe.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Alright, we'll get to that because that's very interesting. Well listen, when you were at the Hotel Vendome did you get the job, did you get to sing there?
Yes. They hired me over there.
No, that was Stuff and them. Guys from home.

And so, you know, Mrs. Clore, Mr. Bill Clore and his wife, and she was very stately, you know. And I said, 'I ain't got no clothes to wear here'. And a friend of mine knew where they had some thrift shops and she said, Helen I'm going to take you to these thrift shops where the people, they buy all their clothes and then they go to Florida. And when they
